borderline-drop, REVERSED AT PHASE 4 DEEP READ. Inclusion rested on PD-11(c): Switzerland appearing among named target geographies. The scoped deep read established that Switzerland appears only as a bare secondary-geography mention inside a mass-scanning footprint of more than 1.1 million internet-facing hosts, with no Swiss victim, sector or organisation class named anywhere in the report — which is a statistical property of indiscriminate scanning, not a home-region nexus. What remains is a single-source vendor report, with no second-party corroboration found, on a Russia-nexus actor scanning a set of already-known older edge CVEs (Sophos XG, FortiOS SSL-VPN, F5 BIG-IP, SAP NetWeaver, Roundcube, FortiWeb) and breaching Ukrainian defence and aerospace firms. The deep read also established that the full CVE list and per-CVE volumes exist only as an unextractable chart image, so the arsenal could not be reported completely. No limb of the gate survives: the CVE set changes nothing a responder does not already do, and the tradecraft (Sliver, webshells, tunnellers, pass-the-hash) is unremarkable.
dropped.note: Russia-nexus targeting of the European defence-industrial base is a legitimate strategic thread for the weekly, where a single-source report can be framed as one input among several rather than carrying an operational entry on its own.
